stories.now: CityNews: Toronto police have identified one of the three suspects wanted in connection with a violent home invasion in the Bridle Path on Thursday. Global News: MAC Group CEO David Morton says his family is recovering after a violent Bridle Path home invasion left three relatives shot and all four attacked with a hammer.
stories.backstory: The attack drew national attention because it took place in the Bridle Path, one of Toronto's wealthiest neighbourhoods. The family's father, David Morton, CEO of MAC Group, has called the experience terrifying and urged anyone with information to come forward. Police say it was the 119th home invasion reported in Toronto this year, up about 32% from the same period in 2025. Chief Myron Demkiw promised a stronger police presence in the area.
